The ESP32 GPIO pins that are input-only are GPIO34 through GPIO39, specifically:

- GPIO34: VDET_1  
- GPIO35: VDET_2  
- GPIO36: SENSOR_VP  
- GPIO37: SENSOR_CAPP  
- GPIO38: CAPN  
- GPIO39: SENSOR_VN  

These pins are input-only and lack output drivers as well as internal pull-up or pull-down circuitry [3].  

This information is explicitly stated in the evidence, which highlights that these pins do not feature an output driver or internal pull-up/pull-down circuitry [3].

CONFLICT: None found in the provided evidence. All references consistently describe GPIO34–39 as input-only with no output driver or pull circuitry. There is no contradictory statement among the references regarding these pins. [3]
